operators.name: Power to decibels
operators.description: 10 log10 of accepted positive calibrated power. A dB difference is a power ratio, not environmental attribution.

operators.name: Phase to relative LOS change
operators.description: Use one fixed common reference and source wavelength to convert phase to cm. Positive is toward the satellite; this is not vertical motion.

operators.name: Displacement to interval rate
operators.description: Divide displacement by exact pair duration. Each pair remains its own interval; rates are not accumulated motion.

operators.name: Reconstruct connected acquisition dates
operators.description: Solve connected referenced LOS pairs for acquired dates, fixing the first date to zero. A tree has no independent closure check.

operators.name: Fit a movement trend
operators.description: Fit an intercept and linear slope to at least three reconstructed dates. Annualization does not mean a year was observed.

operators.name: Subtract an observed baseline
operators.description: Subtract the per-cell median of the first N observations. Every baseline observation must be valid. The first N frames are the declared baseline, not a climate normal.

operators.name: Smooth without filling gaps
operators.description: Normalized Gaussian smoothing with reflected edges and at least 30% finite kernel support. Missing central cells remain missing. Sigma uses actual analysis-cell spacing; smoothing changes spatial support, not sensor resolution.

operators.name: Make a labelled candidate mask
operators.description: Apply a declared threshold in the current units. Categories are candidate conditions, not confirmed environmental classes.

operators.name: Keep connected candidate patches
operators.description: Remove four-connected candidate patches smaller than a physical area on the equal-area analysis grid. Only valid after a threshold.

operators.name: Summarize the observed record
operators.description: Create mean, median, spread or observed candidate frequency on cells valid at every selected date. Dates remain discrete observations.

operators.name: Classify water candidates
operators.description: Compound radiometric decision: use one gamma-zero threshold or the joint HH/HV sigma-zero rule.
operators.limitation: Low radar brightness can also be smooth dry ground or shadow. These are candidates, not verified water.

operators.name: Compare new water and later dry observations
operators.description: Use the median pre-comparison brightness as baseline; identify new water and bounds on an observed return to dry.
operators.limitation: No later observation means unresolved, not still flooded. Acquisition gaps remain unknown.

operators.name: Summarize observed wetness across dates
operators.description: Compute candidate occupancy, intermittent/always-observed areas and zone trajectories on common support.
operators.limitation: Observation frequency is not continuous hydroperiod or vegetation-specific inundation.

operators.name: Track connected water-candidate patches
operators.description: Link candidate objects by observed overlap and retain patches above a physical area.
operators.limitation: Links are spatial correspondences, not measured water flow or uninterrupted persistence.

operators.name: Compare HH and HV against per-view baselines
operators.description: Compound block: median linear-power baselines, separate HH/HV log ratios, absolute sum and latest-view fusion.
operators.limitation: Each view needs at least three baseline dates and a later date. Views may be asynchronous; change is not confirmed fire.

operators.name: Normalize change with a robust score
operators.description: Subtract the scene median and divide by 1.4826 times its median absolute deviation.
operators.limitation: This score depends on the study domain. It is not a probability or burn-severity index.

operators.name: Declare the observed brightness baseline
operators.description: Convert positive power to dB and calculate a median baseline and robust spread from the declared first dates.
operators.limitation: A baseline during an eruption cannot reveal lava already unchanged at that time.

operators.name: Find brightening and dimming candidates
operators.description: Apply separate positive and negative departure thresholds, with physical patch filtering.
operators.limitation: Moisture, snow, roughness and geometry can mimic the same changes.

operators.name: Separate new, transient and repeated changes
operators.description: Record first observed changes and consecutive latest same-sign support.
operators.limitation: Repeated evidence needs at least two later acquisitions; it does not prove uninterrupted persistence or lava.

operators.name: Select earthquake-bracketing measurements
operators.description: Select the shortest intervals that strictly bracket the documented event; optionally include compatible adjacent views.
operators.limitation: Other motion within each interval is not separated from the event.

operators.name: Reference, convert and combine event views
operators.description: Compound geometry block: common-reference phase-to-LOS conversion and quality-aware event coverage mosaic.
operators.limitation: Each view retains its dates and reference evidence. LOS is not vertical motion or building damage.

operators.name: Screen radar-offset measurements
operators.description: Apply the declared local and/or robust spatial outlier rules to both offset components.
operators.limitation: Filtering can remove real localized motion; compare its rejection maps and an unfiltered run.

operators.name: Optionally subtract stable-ground bias
operators.description: Subtract each component median in the supplied stable-terrain polygon when enabled.
operators.limitation: A polygon label does not prove stability. Enabled correction requires usable stable pixels.

operators.name: Estimate horizontal velocity from viewing geometry
operators.description: Compound inversion: combine range/along-track offsets with delivered ENU viewing vectors, fixing vertical velocity to zero.
operators.limitation: Slope-parallel and vertical motion can bias this estimate. Constant ellipsoidal height is not a terrain DEM.

operators.name: Keep radar-direction motion components
operators.description: Keep signed range/along-track rates and their filtered radar-plane magnitude.
operators.limitation: Radar-plane magnitude is not geographic horizontal speed.

operators.name: Choose daily or annualized motion units
operators.description: Use each exact pair duration, with optional multiplication by 365.25.
operators.limitation: An annualized interval rate is not a full year of observations.

operators.name: Choose the opening result map
operators.description: Keep the method maps, dated observations, diagnostics and exports; choose the main map to inspect.
operators.limitation: Changing presentation or selecting a map does not establish environmental accuracy.

operators.name: Smooth quality-screened input measurements
operators.description: Optional Gaussian smoothing on the analysis grid before the compound method, preserving missing central cells and quality evidence.
operators.limitation: This is an added experiment: it changes inputs, can blend real features and does not improve native resolution.

checks.message: Decibels can only be added first to unchanged GCOV power.
Convert phase to relative movement first, once only.
First reconstruct connected LOS dates after phase-to-LOS, optionally smoothed, before baselines, rates or masks.
First reconstruct connected LOS acquisition dates before fitting a trend.
Add a rate immediately after displacement, before other calculations.
A single fitted map has no time baseline to subtract.
A baseline requires measurements, not candidate labels.
Smooth measurements before creating category labels.
Choose a numeric output before adding a threshold.
An absolute-magnitude threshold must be nonnegative.
First mark values that meet a condition, then filter candidate patches.
Keep the single fitted map with Mean, or use frequency for a candidate mask.
Use candidate frequency for labels; use a measurement statistic for numeric values.

water_rule.message: The flood baseline requires the single-channel rule. Use Wetland history for joint HH/HV.

threshold.message: The combined-score classifier needs an at-or-above threshold greater than 0 and at most 20 in z units.

event_pairs.message: Supply the documented event timestamp or date.

common_checks.message: The summary must be last. Move new calculations before it.
First convert phase to relative ground movement.
